details:
NASA Astronaut Health Monitoring & Prediction System

About the Project

Our project is an intelligent health monitoring and prediction system designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It tracks the crew’s physical condition, predicts potential changes in health parameters, and provides personalized recommendations based on available data.

During spaceflight, the human body is exposed to challenging conditions such as microgravity, radiation, and isolation. These factors can affect the cardiovascular system, muscles, sleep patterns, and overall well-being. Early detection of changes in an astronaut’s health is essential for preventing potential problems and supporting crew safety.

Key Features

1. Health Monitoring

The system tracks 10 health parameters for each astronaut. Data is displayed through interactive visualizations, allowing users to monitor physical condition, identify changes, and detect possible deviations from normal values.

2. AI-Powered Suggestions

Based on health data, the system generates personalized recommendations to help astronauts maintain their well-being during a mission. Examples include recommendations about hydration, sleep, and daily habits.

3. Health Predictions

The system forecasts possible changes in health parameters over different periods: 1, 7, and 30 days. These predictions help identify potential risks in advance and support preventive decision-making.

4. Data Visualization & Explanations

Health information is presented through clear graphs, indicators, and explanations. Users can not only see how their parameters change but also understand what those changes may mean.

5. Mission & Crew Management

The platform allows users to select astronauts, monitor their locations, and account for different mission environments, including Earth, low Earth orbit, deep space, Mars orbit, and planetary surfaces.

Project Goal

Our goal is to develop an intelligent health support system for astronauts that combines real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and personalized recommendations in one platform.

Instead of simply displaying current health data, the system aims to anticipate potential changes and help the crew take preventive action before problems arise.

Our vision: Monitor today. Predict tomorrow. Protect astronauts throughout their mission.
